values.value: Used by the Outbound Funds migration kit, which reads the disbursements of awarded funding requests: one disbursement of the award per record, with its amount, scheduled and paid dates, status and payment method. A Paid disbursement is only saved by someone with Manage Scholarships, so run this step as that person.

{"version": 2, "uniqueBy": ["Id"], "columns": [{"source": "outfunds.Funding_Request__c", "target": "Record.Award__c"}, {"source": "outfunds.Amount__c", "target": "Record.Amount__c"}, {"source": "outfunds.Scheduled_Date__c", "target": "Record.Scheduled_Date__c"}, {"source": "outfunds.Disbursement_Date__c", "target": "Record.Paid_Date__c"}, {"source": "outfunds.Status__c", "target": "Record.Status__c", "transforms": [{"op": "map", "pairs": [{"text": "Scheduled", "value": "Scheduled"}, {"text": "Pending", "value": "Scheduled"}, {"text": "Approved", "value": "Scheduled"}, {"text": "Paid", "value": "Paid"}, {"text": "Disbursed", "value": "Paid"}, {"text": "Cancelled", "value": "Cancelled"}, {"text": "Canceled", "value": "Cancelled"}], "otherwise": "Scheduled"}, {"op": "ifBlank", "value": "Scheduled"}]}, {"source": "outfunds.Disbursement_Method__c", "target": "Record.Payment_Method__c", "transforms": [{"op": "map", "pairs": [{"text": "Check", "value": "Check"}, {"text": "EFT", "value": "Bank Transfer"}, {"text": "ACH", "value": "Bank Transfer"}, {"text": "Wire", "value": "Bank Transfer"}, {"text": "Wire Transfer", "value": "Bank Transfer"}, {"text": "Credit Card", "value": "Card"}, {"text": "Card", "value": "Card"}], "otherwise": "Other"}]}]}
